GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
  
RAJYA SABHA 
 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 113 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 02.02.2022 
 
LOW PLACEMENTS UNDER SKILL INDIA MISSION 
 
113.  SMT. PHULO DEVI NETAM: 
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPREN EURSHIP 
be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the fund allocated to the Skill India Mission, n ationally and State- 
wise, year wise during last five years; 
 
(b)  the placement percentage attained across the country at an aggregate as 
well as State level and the Government's placement targets, year-wise 
during last five years; 
 
(c)  the reasons for low placement rate of the programme; 
 
(d)  whether Government has evaluated how the focus on short-term skilI 
courses under the Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) programme has led to 
a high number of certifications but low employment rate under the scheme; 
and 
 
(e)  if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
 SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP
 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) Under the Skill India Mission, the Government is implementing various Skill 
Development Schemes/Programmes across Central Ministries/Departments, for 
providing a range of Skill Development training programmes on pan India basis. 
Funds allocated by Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) for 
Skill India Mission during the last five (5) years stands at Rs. 14,211.84 crore. As per 
details available in respect of 11 major Ministries/Departments an amount of more 
than Rs 12850 crore has been allocated during last 5 years.  MSDE is implementing 
various schemes viz. Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), National 
Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS), Craftsman Training Scheme (CTS) and 
Jan Sikhshan Sansthan (JSS), for providing skill training to youths across the 
country. The  fund  allocation  in  the  Ministry  is  made  scheme-wise  and  not  
State/District-wise.  The  details of fund allocated to the Skill India Mission under 
MSDE year wise during last five years  is attached at Annexure-I.   The 11 major 
M
inistries/Departments are those of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME) , 
Rural Development (RD), Housing & Urban Affairs (H&UA), Social Justice & 
Empowerment (SJ&E), Textiles, Youth Affairs & Sports, Tourism, (D/o) Promotion of 
Industry and Internal Trade, Mines, (D/o) Animal Husbandry, Dairying & Fisheries 
and (D/o) Public Enterprise.  
388

 
(b) PMKVY: Placement percentage attained across the country at an aggregate 
as well as State level under  PMKVY is attached at Annexure II (1-3) . As per the 
Third Party Evaluation Report on PMKVY 2.0 (2016-20), it was found that average 
monthly income of PMKVY trained and certified individuals was 15% higher than the 
comparison group. Moreover, 76% of the candidates acknowledged that after the 
training, they have better chance of getting employment. 
JSS: The objective of training imparted under JSS is to link the individuals for gainful 
livelihood and supplement their family income through self-employment and wage 
employment. The providing of employment/placement to the beneficiaries is not the 
mandate of the JSS Scheme. As far as the employment of the JSS scheme 
beneficiaries is concerned, third party evaluation report of the scheme has 
mentioned, “It is finally observed that as an impact of the training programme 
conducted at JSSs, the self and wage employment and private job have become 
evident”. The usefulness of the scheme would be further self-evident from the fact 
that same report has mentioned that 77.05% of the beneficiary trainees have under 
gone occupational shifts. 
CTS: The final report of Tracer Study of ITI Graduates (published in January 2018 by 
the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, GoI) mentions that 63.5% of 
total ITI pass-outs got employed (wage+ self, out of which 6.7% are self-employed) 
and 36.4% remained unemployed and was looking for jobs.  
NAPS: Placements are not tracked in NAPS 
(c)   NITI Aayog has done a quick assessment study of the PMKVY 2.0. The report 
of NITI Aayog highlighted a mismatch between industry requirement and candidate 
expectation. In addition, National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), an 
implementing agency of PMKVY, has also engaged a third-party agency, Sambodhi 
Research and Communications Pvt. Ltd., for the impact evaluation of PMKVY 2.0. 
This report highlighted about 15% increase in average monthly salary under STT 
and 19% under RPL. Under RPL, 70% participants reported for better chance of 
finding employment. This report also suggested for stronger role of State Skill 
Development Missions (SSDMs) for better implementation of scheme. Based on the 
above said studies and learning from the implementation of PMKVY 2.0, Ministry has 
launched a modified version of PMKVY, i.e., PMKVY 3.0 on 15.01.2021 with a 
demand-driven and bottom-up approach.  
 
(d)& (e) Under the PMKVY, Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)  is a skill 
certiﬁcation component to enable Indian youth to obtain industry relevant skill 
certification of their existing skills so as to help them to secure a better livelihood. 
Individuals with prior learning experience or skills register themselves and get 
assessed and certiﬁed under the RPL. Since RPL involves the process of 
certification of skills already existing in workers, it (RPL) is not linked with 
placements; the workers are presumed to be employed already.

SKILL DEVELOPMENT IN RAJASTHAN 
 
#114 DR. K.J. ALPHONS:  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPREN EURSHIP 
be pleased to state: 
 
(a) how many people have been skilled in Rajasthan d uring the last five years, 
district-wise and skill-wise;  
 
(b) how many of these persons have been employed; and 
 
(c) what is the target for the next three years, skill-wise? 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTER OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) The Government is implementing various Skill Development 
Schemes/Programmes across Central Ministries/Departments, for providing a range 
of Skill Development training programmes on pan India basis. Skill India Mission has 
been implementing Pradhan Mantri Kaushal VikasYojana (PMKVY), Jan Shikshan 
Sansthan (JSS) Scheme and National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS), 
for providing short term Skill Development training and Craftsmen Training Scheme 
(CTS), for long term training, to the youth belonging to all sections of the society 
across India. 
The district-wise, skill-wise data for Rajasthan for the Schemes of this Ministry for 
last five years are given in the Annexures. As far as other Ministries are concerned, 
the Ministry of Rural Development has trained and placed/settled in Rajasthan 
people under 2 major schemes Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana 
and Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (DDU-GKY & RSETI). The Ministry of 
U
rban Development has trained and settled people under National Urban 
Livelihoods Mission (NULM).  
S
ince the data as regards people who have been skilled & employed in 
Rajasthan during the last five years, district-wise and skill-wise, through the 
aforesaid Schemes,are voluminous, all of them have been placed on the website of 
the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship 
394

(Link:https://www.msde.gov.in/en/useful-links/parl-ques/rajya-sabha). The annexures 
at the mentioned link are as given below: 
 
Annexure I: Data, as required, for the PMKVY 
Annexure II: Data, as required, for the JSS 
Annexure III: Data, as required, for the NAPS 
Annexure IV: Data, as required, for the CTS 
Annexure V: DDU-GKY and RSETI data from the Ministry of RD and the NULM data 
from the Ministry of UD, for last 3 years, for Rajasthan. RSETI uses the category 
settled, and not placed. 
(b)   The numbers of people placed (as reported) under the schemes PMKVY and 
JSS are given in Annexure I and II, respectively even though only the PMKVY has 
the mandate to track placement. Since NAPS is an apprenticeship related scheme, 
no placement is tracked. Again, as far as the CTS is concerned, No such tracking is 
done. However, as per the Final report on Tracer Study of ITI Graduates (published 
in January 2018 by the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, GoI) 
shows that 63.5% of total ITI pass-outs got employed (wage+self, out of which 6.7% 
are self-employed) and 36.4% remained unemployed and was looking for jobs.  
Even though the first figure was low for females (55.3%) as compared to that for 
males (65.1%), the figures for SCs (65%) and STs (69.8%) were higher than the 
percentage of total pass-outs in (wage+self) employed. But, all these figures are for 
the country as a whole and not for Rajasthan only. For the DDU-GKY, RSETI and 
NULM the number of placed/settled people in Rajasthan in last 3 years are given in 
Annexure-V. 
(c)     No such targets can be set since the programmes are demand-driven and the 
demand depends on various factors, changing patterns of demand from industries 
and their respective growth rates of requirement.

provide training and develop entrepreneurship skill among the youth ; 
(
b) if so, the details thereof; and  
(
c) the programmes being conducted under this scheme, particularly in the State of

ecosystem through entrepreneurship education, training, advocacy and easy access to 
entrepreneurship network. The project, at an estimated cost of Rs. 12.00 crore, covers 
10 States and 2 Union Territories viz. Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Bihar, West Bengal,

functioning under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship such as 
Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs), Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKKs), Jan 
Shikshan Sansthans (JSSs) and Polytechnics. The main aim of the Pilot Project is to 
promote entrepreneurship as an alternate career choice and provide mentoring support 
to potential and early-stage entrepreneurs, by imparting entrepreneurship education and 
mentoring support to trainees/ beneficiaries from skilling ecosystem.

116.  SHRI K.R. SURESH REDDY:  
 
    Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government is aware that women entrepreneurs in the country are 
compelled to run nano or micro ventures such as selling vegetables for survival and basic 
needs and since earning through them is not much, they are unable to expand; and 
 
(b)  if so, the remedial steps taken by Government to help such entrepreneurs to grow 
their businesses with institutional backing and credit?  
  
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a)   Women have been running nano or micro ventures, including selling vegetables, for 
decades, as part of the overall informal sector of the country’s economy. As per the 
Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) conducted by the National Statistical Office (NSO) 
for the year July, 2019- June, 2020, the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) is 24.7% 
for rural women and 18.5% for urban women. Further, share of self employed among 
workers is 63% among rural women and 34.6% among urban women. 
 
 
(b)  In order to support women entrepreneurs running small ventures (nano/micro 
ventures), Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is implementing 
various programmes to encourage women entrepreneurship in the country as mentioned 
below:-
 
 
(i)        ‘Economic Empowerment of Women Entrepreneurs and Startups by Women 
(WEE)’ is being implemented in collaboration with Deutsche Gesellschaftfür Internationale 
Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) Germany to pilot incubation and acceleration programmes for 
women micro entrepreneurs, enabling them to start new businesses and scale up existing 
enterprises in the States of Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh and North 
Eastern region of the country. 
 
(ii)        Pilot Project on Entrepreneurship Development (PM YUVA)  has been 
launched in November, 2019 for creating an enabling ecosystem through 
entrepreneurship education, training, advocacy and easy access to entrepreneurship 
397

network, for students and alumni of skill training institutes viz.  Industrial Training Institutes 
(ITIs), Polytechnics, Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) and Jan Shikshan Sansthan 
(JSS). The scheme covers 10 States and 2 Union Territories. 
 
 
(iii)       Entrepreneurship Promotion and Mentoring of Micro and Small Businesses 
in Six Holy Cities : The project seeks to catalyse local entrepreneurial activities through 
involvement of potential and existing entrepreneurs, through entrepreneurship awareness, 
education and mentoring in Pandharpur, Puri, Varanasi, Haridwar, Kollur and Bodh Gaya.  
 
(iv)       Apart from above, in order to enhance the employability of female workers, the 
Government is providing training to them through a network of Women Industrial Training 
Institutes, National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs), Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 
(PMKVY) Centers and Pradhan Mantri Kaushal  Kendras (PMKKs).
 
   
Further, the details of major programmes/schemes of other Ministries of Central 
Government for development of entrepreneurship including women are given below. 
 
• Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMYY)  of Ministry of Finance, Department of 
Financial Services was launched by the Hon’ble Prime Minister on 8 th April, 2015 to 
extend collateral free loans below Rs. 10 Lakh through Member Lending Institutions 
(MLIs) to individuals to enable them to set up or expand their business activities. The 
scheme facilitates loans in three categories namely Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore 
(Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 Lakh) and Tarun (Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh) for income generating 
activities in Manufacturing, Trading, Services sector and also for the activities allied to 
agriculture. Under PMMY, being implemented across the Country, over 32.86 crore loans 
have been extended, out of which 22.26 crore loans have been extended to women 
category entrepreneurs as on 21.01.2022. 
 
 
• Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is implementing Pradhan Mantri Street 
Vendors’ Atma Nirbhar Nidhi Scheme (PM SVANidhi)  since June 01, 2020 to facilitate 
working capital loan of upto10,000 of 1 year tenure to Street Vendors, vending in urban 
areas, to resume their businesses, adversely impacted by the pandemic. On prepayment 
or repayment, they are eligible for an enhanced working capital loan of upto 20,000 and 
50,000 in the second and third tranches respectively. In addition, ‘SVANidhi se 
Samriddhi’ initiative, designed to build safety net for the beneficiaries’ families by linking 
them to existing socio-economic welfare schemes of Government of India. It was launched 
in January 2021 for 125 select cities. 
 
• Stand-up India Scheme of Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services 
was launched Pan-India by the Hon’ble Prime Minister on 5 th April, 2016 and has been 
extended up to the year 2025. The objective of the Stand UP India Scheme is to facilitate 
loans from Scheduled Commercial banks (SCBs) of value between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 
crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and one 
woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a Greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, 
398

service or trading sector. Under Stand Up India Scheme as on 24.01.2022, out of 1,30,302 
loans 1,05,678 loans have been extended to women category entrepreneurs. 
 
• Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP) , the sub-scheme under 
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihood Mission (DAY-NRLM) 
implemented by Ministry of Rural Development since 2016-17, has the objective of helping 
Self Help Group (SHG) and their family members to set-up small enterprises in the non-
farm and off-farm sector. SVEP projects are implemented in a block and are of four-year 
duration. The objective of SVEP is to help the rural poor come out of poverty by helping 
them set up enterprises and provide support till the enterprises stabilize. Till December, 
2021, a total of 1,86,576 enterprises are supported under the scheme across 23 
States/UTs.
 
 
• The Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP)  was launched on 8 March, 2018 
on the occasion of the International Women’s Day as NITI Aayog’s flagship initiative. WEP 
has pan India coverage and does not have state specific programme/s. Registration on 
the portal and all subsequent services are provided free of cost for WEP users. WEP 
caters to both aspiring and well established women in the space of entrepreneurship.

118 #  SHRI Y.S. CHOWDARY:  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPREN EURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether any review has been done of the National  Policy on Skill Development 
and Entrepreneurship launched in 2015, in view of change in technology and 
environment;  
 
(b) if so, the details thereof;  
 
(c) how far the integration of formal education with skill development has been 
achieved in the country, the details thereof; and  
 
(d) how many apprenticeship training courses were offered to the eligible youths in 
the country, especially in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana during the last five years, the 
details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
  
(a)&(b) The Steering Committee of National Skill Development Mission in its 2nd meeting 
on June 29, 2021, has proposed to undertake the review of National Policy for Skill 
Development and Entrepreneurship. The work on the same is in progress. Alignment 
with global standards has always been a part of Policies and Guidelines of Ministry of 
Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. All NSQF Qualifications Packs and Curriculum 
contain references to global standards wherever needed. 
 
(c) Govt of India has introduced Vocational Education at Schools through a centrally 
sponsored scheme known as Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan scheme. This scheme is 
providing fund to the 28 States and 8 UTs for introducing Vocational Education from 
Class 9th to Class 12th. There are 20 Sector Skill Councils working in this space and 125 
approved job roles are being implemented through NSDC empanelled vocational training 
providers. Total 13,775 schools have been adopted for vocational education at school 
level. The summary of State-wise adoption of vocational education at the school level is 
mentioned in Annexure I.  
 
Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship has recently signed a Memorandum of 
Understanding (MoU) with Indira Gandhi Open University (IGNOU), the partnership aims 
to link vocational education and training with higher education, making India’s youth 
employable by creating avenues for them to access better work opportunities. The 
trainees attached to National Skill Training Institutes (NSTI), Industrial Training Institutes 
402

(ITI), Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKK) and Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) will 
benefit from the programme, aimed at creating upward mobility of these students to be 
able to attain higher education for better livelihood opportunities. Under the partnership, 
32 NSTIs, more than 3,000 Government it is, 500 PMKKs and nearly 300 JSS will be 
associated with IGNOU as Registration Centres, Examination Centres and Work Centres 
for hands on training. Through the collaboration, students will now get an opportunity to 
join the three-year degree programme of IGNOU. There shall be a Project Steering 
Committee with representatives from both MSDE and IGNOU to monitor and review the 
progress of the programme. The MoU is in alignment with the Sustainable Development 
Goal 4.4 and the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 for increasing Gross Enrolment 
Ratio (GER) in higher education including vocational education to 50% by 2035. 
 
(d) National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS):  This Scheme is for 
promoting apprenticeship training and increasing the engagement of apprentices by 
providing financial support to industrial establishments undertaking apprenticeship 
programme under The Apprentices Act, 1961. Training consists of Basic Training and 
On-the-Job Training / Practical Training at workplace in the industry. No apprenticeship 
course is run by the Ministry-various establishments engage apprentices and the 
Government provides support for in-house training of such apprentices. Details of 
apprentices (trade-wise) for whom Government extended financial support under the 
NAPS, especially in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana is at Annexure-II & III respectively.

DDRCs IN THE COUNTRY 
  
129.  SHRI SANJAY SETH: 
 
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state: 
  
(a) whether it is fact that Government is setting up District Disability Rehabilitation Centres 
under Deen Dayal Rehabilitation Scheme in the country; 
 (b) if so, the State-wise the details thereof; 
(c) whether it is also a fact that the desired results could not come out under  this scheme; and 
(d) if so, the steps Government will take in this regard? 
  
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT 
(SUSHRI PRATIMA BHOUMIK) 
  
(a) & (b): Yes, Sir. The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities is 
implementing a scheme namely District Disability Rehabilitation Centres (DDRCs) under the 
Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS) under which financial assistance is provided 
to set up and operate DDRCs at District level. A statement indicating State/District-wise 
financial assistance provided to DDRCs during the last three years and current year is 
at Annexure-I. 
  
(c) & (d):  To assess the impact of DDRCs under the DDRS scheme, an impact evaluation study 
of the scheme of DDRS was carried out in 2021 by the National Institute of Labour Economics 
Research and Development (NILERD), an autonomous organisation under the NITI Aayog.  The 
recommendations of the study indicated that additional DDRCs need to be established in the 
country and that their establishment may be linked to the disabled population of the district.  The 
existing Scheme guidelines under revision have incorporated provisions for including all districts 
of the country being eligible for setting up DDRCs as against the initially identified 325 districts 
only; rehabilitation professionals being appointed on part-time basis in view of the shortage of 
such professionals across the country and mandatorily appointing at least 4 rehabilitation 
professionals for running DDRCs to provide rehabilitation services to persons with disabilities 
(PwDs). The Expenditure Finance Committee has recommended continuation of the DDRS 
Scheme for a period of next five years. 
  
Presently about 60 DDRCs are actively providing services to PwDs, including those 
related to early identification and intervention, awareness generation, assessment of 
need/provision/fitment of assistive devices, therapeutic services like physiotherapy, occupational 
therapy, speech therapy, referral and arrangement of surgical correction, assistance in providing 
scholarships, skill training, loans for self-employment, survey and identification of PwDs 
through camp approach, assistance in the issue of Unique Disability Identity (UDID) cards, to act 
as outreach centre for the services provided by the National Institutes and promoting barrier free 
environment.

POPULARISING TRIBAL PRODUCTS 
  
 135. DR. C. M. RAMESH: 
 
Will the Minister of Tribal Affairs be pleased to state:  
  
(a) the details of efforts made by Government to popularise tribal products in the country, the details 
thereof; and 
 (b) how many exhibitions have been arranged by Government in different States of the country for 
creation of markets for such products and the response received in that regard from general public, 
especially youth in the country, the details thereof? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
(a) to (b): Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA) has taken various initiatives to market the products made 
by the tribal people which include the following: 
(i) The Ministry provides funds to States and TRIFED for organizing tribal festivals wherein the tribal 
artists and artisans showcase and sell their products.  The details of National Tribal festival (Adi-
Mahotsav), State level Adi Mahotsav organized by TRIFED and funds given to different State 
Governments for organizing such festivals is given in Annexure. 
These festivals and exhibitions showcase their traditional skill in painting, art and craft, organic products 
and also demonstrate glimpses of rich cultural heritage through unique forms of folk dances, songs, 
cuisine,. However during 2020-21and 2021-22,due to covid, pandemic the States and TRIFED were 
advised to organize such festival after following covid protocol and also to explore digital exhibitions.  
(ii) MoTA provides funds to TRIFED and State Governments for marketing of tribal products by 
empanelling tribal suppliers comprising of individual tribal artisans, tribal SHGs, Organisations/ 
Agencies/NGOs working with tribals. 
(iii) TRIFED also organizes Tribal Artisan Mela (TAM) at District/Tehsil level as an exercise to reach 
tribals located in interior tribal areas and source tribal art and craft directly from them. Through this 
initiative, Tribal Artisans are invited to an exhibition area where they display their art and craft items.  
(iv) TRIFED is also engaged in direct sale of tribal products including art & craft items through its 
network of Tribes India Showrooms, exhibitions, Aadi Mahotsav, online e-commerce portal etc.

(c) whether Government has any proposal to address the lack of basic amenities, 
infrastructure, filling up of vacancies, increasing faculties, allocation of more funds in

be sanctioned by 2022 based on provision of suitable land by the States.

INCLUSION OF SIX INDIGENOUS COMMUNITIES IN ST LIST 
  
137.   SHRI RIPUN BORA: 
          
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
  
a. whether Government intends to list 6 indigenous communities from Assam-Koch 
Rajbongshi, Tai Ahom, Chutia, Matak, Moran and Tea Tribes in the Scheduled Tribe list; 
b. if so, the timeline by which the same will be notified and if not, the reasons therefor; 
c. whether Government intends to take any measures to secure the well-being of the six 
communities without hampering the rights and quotas of the existing Schedule Tribes 
thereof; and 
d. if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SHRI BISHWESWAR TUDU) 
  
(a) & (b):  The recommendation for inclusion of Matak, Maran, Tai Ahom & Chutia, Koch 
Rajbongshi and Tea-tribes has been received from the State Govt. of Assam. The Government of 
India on 15.6.1999 (further amended on 25.6.2002), has laid down the modalities for determining 
the claims for inclusion in, exclusion from and other modifications in the Orders specifying list of 
Scheduled Tribes. According to these modalities, only those proposals which have been 
recommended and justified by the concerned State Government/ Union Territory Administration 
and concurred with by the Registrar General of India (RGI) and the National Commission for 
Scheduled Tribes are to be considered for amendment of legislation. All actions are taken as per 
these modalities. 
  
(c) & (d):  A committee of Ministers was constituted by the then State Govt. of Assam on 
14.01.2019. No proposal based on the recommendation of the Committee has been received.

DISPLACEMENT OF TRIBALS DUE TO POLAVARAM DAM 
  
138. DR. SASMIT PATRA:   
  
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
  
(a) the total number of tribals to be displaced in different States due to the Polavaram Dam, State-wise; 
(b) whether Gram Sabhas have been held to hear the tribal's concerns before proceeding with the 
construction of Polavaram Dam; and 
(c) the steps undertaken to protect the land and livelihood of the tribals affected by the Polavaram Dam? 
   
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SHRI BISHWESHWAR TUDU) 
  
(a) As per information provided by the Polavaram Project Authority (PPA), Department of Water 
Resources, RD & GR, Ministry of Jal Shakti and by the Water Resources Department (WRD), 
Government of Andhra Pradesh (GoAP) that total number of Project Displaced Families (PDFs) in 
Andhra Pradesh is 1,06,006; out of which 56,504 PDFs (43,689- East Godavari Distt. & 12,815- West 
Godavari Distt.) comprising of 1,64,752 persons as per 2011 census belong to the tribal community, 
due to construction of Polavaram Irrigation Project. The PDFs are tentative though the Socio Economic 
Survey (SES) was completed in +45 Contour of Chinturu & Yetapaka Units, PDF nos will be finalized 
only after approval of draft R&R Schemes. 
 
PPA has also informed that the Project envisages construction of Protective embankments in the 
territory of Odisha & Chhattisgarh to avoid submergence. However, if Protective embankments are not 
constructed in the territory of Odisha & Chhattisgarh, then the number of Project Affected Families 
(PAFs) in Odisha State are 1,002 (Out of which 913 PAFs belong to tribal community) and Project 
Affected Families in Chhattisgarh State are 2,335 (out of which 1294 PAFs belong to tribal community). 
  
(b) Water Resources Department (WRD), Govt. of Andhra Pradesh (GoAP) has informed that as per 
Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Extension to Scheduled Areas (APESA) Act 1996, the Gram Sabhas in all 
the affected areas of Polavaram Irrigation Project have been conducted in the three Districts of 
combined State of Andhra Pradesh (before bifurcation) i.e., East Godavari - 8 Nos of Gram Panchayats, 
West Godavari - 8 Nos Gram Panchayats and Khamma - 60 Nos of Gram Panchayats . 
  
(c) WRD, GoAP has informed that the Tribal PDFs who lost their lands were provided equivalent land 
to land or upto Ac. 2.50 cts whichever is low. The Tribal PDFs were rehabilitated in the Scheduled 
Areas to retain their ethnic, linguistic and cultural identity.  
 
WRD, GoAP further informed that under 2 nd schedule of the Right to Fair Compensation and 
Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013 an 
amount of Rs. 6.86 lakhs are being paid. In addition to the above, Un-employed youth are giving training 
in skill development programmes to eke out their livelihood.

141. SHRI MALLIKARJUN KHARGE: 
  
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
a. whether a Special Court has been set up to try cases under the SC/ST Prevention of 
Atrocities Act, 1989 in all the districts of the country as mandated under Section 14 of the 
Act; 
b.   if so, the details thereof along with the details of States/districts where it has not been 
set up, and if not, the reasons therefor ; and 
c. the number of cases filed under the Act during the last three years and the pendency 
of  such cases thereof? 
  
  
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SHRI BISHWESWAR TUDU) 
 
(a)To (b) : Section 14 of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) 
{PoA} Act. 1989 as amended by Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of 
Atrocities) Amendment Act, 2015 specifies that for the purpose of providing for speedy trial, the 
State Government shall, with the concurrence of the Chief Justice of the High Court, establish an 
Exclusive Special Court for one or more Districts. Further in the Districts where less number of cases 
under the Act is recorded, State Government shall with the concurrence of the Chief Justice of the 
High Court specify for such Districts, the Court of Session to be a Special Court to try the offences 
under the Act. 
  
(c): At the Central level, as per the Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961, 
responsibility in regard to implementation of the Acts, for Criminal offences against members of the 
SCs, STs, including those under the PCR Act, 1955 and the PoA Act,1989;rests with the Ministry of 
Home Affairs and the latest data is provided by NCRB,MHA. State/UT-wise cases registered(CR), 
cases charge-sheeted(CCS), cases convicted(CON), cases pending trial at the end of the year(CPT), 
persons arrested(PAR), persons charge-sheeted(PCS)and persons convicted(PCV) under SC/ST 
(Prevention of Atrocities) Act only for Crime/Atrocities against Scheduled Castes (SCs) and 
Scheduled Tribes (STs) during 2018-2020 is enclosed at Annexure-I & II respectively.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 142 
TO BE ANSWERED ON- 02/02/2022 
  
ENHANCING SOCIAL AND FINANCIAL SECURITY OF TRIBAL COMMUNITY  
  
142. DR. AMEE YAJNIK:          
 
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the details of steps taken by Government to enhance social and financial security of tribal 
community in the last three years, State wise; 
(b) the number of tribal communities shifted from their usual place of residence due to several 
Central Government projects; 
(c) whether Government has completed rehabilitation for such shifted tribal communities; and 
(d) if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
  
(a) Government is implementing various schemes/programmes to enhance social and financial 
security of the marginalized and hitherto socio-economically neglected communities including 
tribals. Some of these are given below:  
i. Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), 2005’ 
provides at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial 
year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.  
ii. National Social Assistance Program (NSAP) is a welfare programme being run to 
provide social security to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in rural and urban areas 
of the country. NSAP consists of five sub schemes.  
iii. Under PM-KISAN scheme, a financial benefit of Rs. 6000/- per year is provided to the 
eligible beneficiary farmer families, payable in three equal 4-monthly installments of 
Rs.2000/- each. 
iv. Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a National Mission for Financial 
Inclusion to ensure access to financial services, namely, Banking/ Savings & Deposit 
Accounts, Remittance, Credit, Insurance, Pension in an affordable manner. 
v. Atal Pension Yojana (APY) allows any Citizen of India between the age group of 18-
40 years to join through the bank or post office branches where one has the savings 
bank account. Under the scheme, a subscriber would receive a minimum guaranteed 
pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month, depending upon his contribution, from the 
age of 60 years. 
vi. Life and disability cover is provided through Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Yojana 
(PMJJBY) for Rs. 2 lakh on death and Pradhan Mantri Surksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) 
for Rs. 2 lakh on accidental death (total Rs. 4 lakh) to the unorganised workers at the 
annual premium of Rs. 342/- (Rs. 330/- for PMJJBY + Rs. 12/- for PMSBY) depending 
upon their eligibility.   
vii. Under Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) collateral free loans of upto Rs. 10 
Lakh are extended by Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) viz Scheduled Commercial 
482

Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks (SFBs), Non-Banking 
Financial Companies (NBFCs), Micro Finance Institutions (MFIs) etc. 
viii. The health and maternity benefits are addressed through Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan 
Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) which is a universal health scheme 
administrated by the National Health Authority. 
ix. Additional allocation of food grain @ 5 kg per person per month free of cost is provided 
to all beneficiaries covered under the targeted public distribution system (Antyodaya 
Anna Yojana & Priority Households), including those covered under Direct Benefit 
Transfer (DBT) under PM Garib Kalyan Ann Yojana.  
  
Ministry of Tribal Affairs is administering the scheme of 'Mechanism for Marketing of Minor 
Forest Produce (MFP) through Minimum Support Price (MSP) and Development of Value 
Chain for MFP' which seeks to establish a system to ensure fair returns for their efforts in 
collection, primary processing, storage, packing, transportation, etc. Under the scheme of MSP 
for MFP, “Van Dhan Vikas Karyakram” an initiative targeting livelihood generation through 
various skill up gradation training and adoption of scientific collection, harvesting and primary 
processing of the MFPs was visualized and set into motion by TRIFED. 
National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC) is an apex 
organisation of Ministry of Tribal Affairs set up for economic development of Scheduled 
Tribes. Corporation provides financial assistance for income generation activities and 
marketing support assistance for economic upliftment of Scheduled Tribes.  
Government is implementing Tribal Sub-Plan (TSP)/Schedule Tribe Component 
(STC)/Development Action Plan for Scheduled Tribes (DAPST) for overall development of 
tribal people across the country. TSP is dedicated source of funds utilized by different Central 
Ministries / Departments under their schemes/programmes for the welfare and development of 
Scheduled Tribes in the country. Year-wise and State-wise details of TSP funds released for 
tribal development by obligated Central Ministries/Departments during last three years are 
placed at Annexure. 
(b) to (d) Ministry of Rural Development, Department of Land Resources (DoLR), which is 
the nodal Ministry dealing with land acquisition matter, have informed that the land acquisition 
is undertaken by the Central and State Governments under various Central and State Acts, 
including the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, 
Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013, which is being administered by 
DOLR and the provisions of the RFCTLARR Act 2013 are implemented by appropriate 
Government as defined under Section 3 (e) of the said Act. DoLR has also informed that they 
do not centrally maintain information relating to land acquisition for States or other Ministries 
/ Departments concerned including details of Displacement of Tribals. 
  
RFCTLARR Act, 2013 stipulates the provisions for Compensation, Rehabilitation and 
Resettlement in the matter of land acquired for public purposes.

144. SHRI DEREK O' BRIEN: 
          
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
(a) the budgetary allocation for the Scheduled Tribe component during the Financial Year 2021-
22;  
(b) what amount of the same has been utilized during the current Financial Year, State-wise 
details thereof; and  
(c) the steps being taken by the Ministry to ensure that the Scheduled Tribe component is not 
being utilized for any activities like illegal mining and displacement of tribal groups, the details 
thereof? 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
(a) The budgetary allocation by the obligated Central Ministries/Departments under 
Development Action Plan for Scheduled Tribes (DAPST)/Tribal Sub Plan (TSP)/Scheduled 
Tribe Component (STC) for the financial year 2021-22 is Rs. 78256.31 crore. Further, as per

Ministries/Departments during current financial year are placed at Annexure I. Further, details

given at Annexure II. 
(c) The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is the nodal Ministry for overall policy, planning and coordination 
of programmes of development for the Scheduled Tribes (STs). However, with regard to 
sectoral programmes and schemes of development of these communities, policy, planning, 
monitoring, evaluation, etc., as also their coordination are the responsibility of the concerned

such schemes which provide specific benefits to STs, setting up of target/deliverables under

LIVELIHOOD OPPORTUNITIES FOR TRIBAL WOMEN 
  
145.  SHRI TIRUCHI SIVA: 
  
Will the Minister of Tribal Affairs be pleased to state:  
(a) whether Government has taken measures to provide livelihood opportunities for tribal women;  
(b) if so, the details thereof; and 
(c) the impact of the measures and the beneficiaries so far, State-wise? 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
  
(a) to (c) The Government has adopted a holistic approach for providing livelihood opportunities to tribal 
population, including tribal women through various schemes of Central Ministries as at Annexure 1.  
National Rural Livelihood Mission administered by Ministry of Rural Development aims at mobilizing all rural 
poor household into self help group, build institutions of poor by federating them at villages / cluster / Block 
level, provide long term support to attain appreciable increase in incomes through credit linkages and multiple 
livelihood options. Women SHGs under DAY-NRLM consist of 10-20 persons. At least one woman member from 
each identified rural poor household, is to be brought under the Self Help Group (SHG) network. The State wise details 
of tribal SHGs created so far are at Annexure 2. 
Ministry of Tribal Affairs strives to achieve inclusive and sustainable growth of tribal population in the country. 
The Centrally Sponsored Schemes/Grants administered by the Ministry which, inter-alia, supports livelihood 
and employment generation for tribal population are under: 
1        Special Central Assistance to Tribal Sub-Scheme (SCA to TSS) 
2         Grant-in-aid under Article 275(1) of the Constitution 
3.        Development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs)  
State-wise details of beneficiaries (including Rajasthan) under these schemes are not centrally maintained in the 
Ministry. However, Ministry of Tribal Affairs has recently developed an online portal 
(https://grants.tribal.gov.in/adigram) to capture physical and financial progress including beneficiary details 
under various schemes being administered.  
Besides, Ministry of Tribal Affairs, through TRIFED and NSTFDC, is implementing the following 
programmes/Schemes which specifically cater to the livelihood needs of the tribal population: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
489

1. Mechanism for Marketing of Minor Forest Produce (MFP) through Minimum Support Price (MSP) and 
Development of Value Chain for MFP.  
2.  Institutional Support for Development & Marketing of Tribal Products/Produce 
3.  Equity Support to National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC)/ 
State Tribal Finance and Development Corporations (STFDCs) 
  
Van Dhan Vikas Karyakram, an initiative under the Scheme ‘Mechanism for Marketing of Minor Forest 
Produce (MFP) through Minimum Support Price (MSP) and Development of Value Chain for MFP’, targets 
livelihood generation for tribals by harnessing the wealth of forest i.e. Van Dhan. Under this programme, it is 
envisaged to set-up tribal community owned Minor Forest Produce centric multi-purpose Kendras in 
predominantly tribal districts. The Kendras would act as common facility centres for procurement cum value 
addition to locally available Minor Forest Produce. Value addition of raw produce is expected to increase the 
value of the MFP considerably and consequently the income of the gatherers. 
The National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC), under the Ministry of Tribal 
Affairs, is implementing an exclusive scheme titled “Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMSY)” for 
economic development of Scheduled Tribes Women. Under the scheme, NSTFDC provides loan upto 90% for 
projects costing upto ₹2.00 lakh. Financial assistance under the scheme is extended at highly concessional rate 
of interest of 4% per annum.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 146 
TO BE ANSWERED ON- 02/02/2022 
  
INTER-STATE TRIBAL LIFE EXPERIENCE 
   
146. SHRI RAKESH SINHA:   
  
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether there are overwhelming tribal population in the North-East, Jharkhand, Chhattishgarh, 
Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, having different customs, value systems in these States; 
 
(b) whether there is any scheme for close interaction of tribal population of these States to learn and 
know from each other's life; 
 
(c) if so, how many tribal groups, specially students got such experience; 
 
(d) if not, whether Government will moot the idea and involve local NGOs to give trial for rich 
experience of their lives in various States; and 
 
(e) whether Government has published encyclopaedia of tribal life in India and their rich cultural 
traditions? 
  
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
  
(a) to (c) Yes, Sir. Ministry of Tribal Affairs under the scheme 'Support to Tribal Research Institutes’ 
inter-alia provides funds to States/UTs for or ganizing Exchange Visit of representatives of   Tribal 
communities/Group.   Further, TRIFED organises Adi Mahotsava under ‘Tribal Festival, Research, 
Information and Mass Education’ scheme across states where tribal artisans across the country 
participates in national and states level festival. The details of above programmes are at Annexure-I. 
 
 In addition to this, following programmes are also arranged for close interaction of tribal population 
at pan India level to learn and know from each other's life; 
 
i. Tribal Talent Pool Programme wherein interactive workshops for tribal scholars are organized.  
ii. Under various scholarships to ST students, students from one study across the country and 
abroad. The schemes help them to interact closely with other students from other States & 
within the States. The details can be seen at dashboard.tribal.gov.in, the dashboard developed 
by the Ministry. 
 
 
  
(d) Does not arise in view of (a) to (c) above.  
  
(e) Ministry of Tribal Affairs provides funds to State Governments under the scheme ‘Support to TRIs’ 
for preparing and publishing encyclopaedias on tribal life in India and their rich cultural traditions. 
Details of encyclopaedias published by States are at Annexure-II. The details of other such documents, 
vedio and photographs depicting tribal life in India and their rich cultural traditions can also be viewed 
on repository.tribal.gov.in.

150   DR. KIRODI LAL MEENA:  
  
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to State: 
 
(a)      Whether   there   has   been   a   rapid   increase   in   the   number   of   incidents
    of exploitation/violence and sexual exploitation of children;  
(b)  If so, State-wise/UT-wise details thereof during the last five years, including 
Rajasthan; and 
(c)  The corrective measures/steps taken/being taken in order to bring down the 
exploitation/violence and sexual exploitation of children? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
 
(a)  to (c)  As per the information provided by National Crime Records Bureau, 
State/UT-Wise and Crime Head-Wise cases registered, cases charge-sheeted, cases 
convicted, persons arrested, persons charge-sheeted and persons convicted under 
crime against children during 2016-2020 is at Annexure I.  
  
The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 enacted by 
Govt of India provides safeguards for children against sexual abuse. The 
act defines a child as any person below the age of 18 years. The POCSO Act 2012 
provides for establishment of Special Courts for the purpose of ensuring speedy trial. 
The Act was amended in 2019 to introduce more stringent punishment including death 
penalty for committing sexual crimes on children, with a view to deter the perpetrators & 
prevent such crimes against children.  
 
Further the POCSO Rules, 2020 were also notified by the Ministry to protect the 
children from exploitation/violence and sexual exploitation.  
 
POCSO Rules, 2020 include provisions for mandatory police verification of staff in 
schools and care homes, procedures to report child sexual abuse material 
(pornography), imparting age-appropriate child rights education, among other things. 
The POCSO Rules 2020 also stipulate that the central government and every state 
government shall provide periodic training including orientation programmes, 
sensitization workshops and refresher courses to all persons, whether regular or 
contractual, coming in contact with the children, to sensitize them about child safety and 
protection and educate them regarding their responsibility under the Act

REQUIREMENT OF HUSBAND’S AADHAAR CARD TO ACCESS BENEFITS OF SCHEMES 
  
152.    SHRI MD. NADIMUL HAQUE: 
                                                 
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
                           
(a) whether it is a fact that women require the Aadhaar card of their husbands to access 
benefits under Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana; 
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; 
(c) whether there are similar requirements in other Government programmes for mother 
or pregnant women, if so, the details thereof; 
(d) whether Government is aware that this excludes potential beneficiaries such as single 
mother, seasonal migrants, abandoned wife etc; 
(e) whether Government has adopted any mechanism to study and to address this gap in 
the programme; and 
(f) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER FOR WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) & (b)         The Ministry of Women and Child Development is implementing Centrally 
Sponsored Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) under which maternity benefits 
of ₹5,000/- is being provided in three instalments to Pregnant Women & Lactating Mothers 
(PW&LM) for the first child upon fulfilment of certain conditionalities. In order to receive the 
maternity benefit under PMMVY, a beneficiary is required to provide her and her husband’s 
Aadhaar details which are captured in the database. 
  
(c)       There is no such requirement under other schemes meant for mother or pregnant 
women being implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development. 
  
(d)       The PMMVY is implemented in all States/Union Territories, except Odisha and 
Telangana. The seasonal migrants can avail the benefits of the scheme from any of the 
State/Union Territory implementing the scheme. 
  
            Further, for registration under the scheme, the beneficiary is, inter-alia, required to 
submit her and her husband's written consent for availing the maternity benefits. 
  
(e) & (f)         The Development & Monitoring Evaluation Office of NITI Aayog has evaluated 
the centrally sponsored schemes of Ministry of Women & Child Development including 
PMMVY and its recommendations have been considered.  Accordingly, it is envisaged that 
the written consent and the aadhaar of husband not to be a mandatory criteria in the modified 
guidelines of PMMVY component under Mission Shakti in order to facilitate inclusion of single 
mother and abandoned mother.

INADEQUACIES IN SWADHAR GREH AND UJJAWALA SCHEMES  
  
153  SHRI MD. NADIMUL HAQUE:   
 
Will the Minister OF WOMEN CHILD AND DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:  
 
(a) whether Government has conducted any study recently to understand the 
inadequacies in Ujjawala child care centres and Swadhar Greh shelter homes; 
  
(b)  if so, the details thereof, including steps adopted to address these issues;   
  
(c) whether it is a fact that most in-house counsellors in such institutions are not 
well-qualified;  
  
(d)  if so, the reasons therefor;   
  
(e) whether it is a fact that these institutions do not enable integration of the 
survivors into the job market upon release from these places; and 
  
(f) if so, the details thereof, including the steps adopted to enable their re-integration 
into the society upon release? 
  
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) to (f) Government implements Ujjawala Scheme for prevention of trafficking and 
rescue, rehabilitation and re-integration of victims of trafficking for commercial sexual 
exploitation. Swadhar Greh Scheme caters to primary needs of women in difficult 
circumstances. Ujjawala and Swadhar Greh Schemes have been evaluated by the NITI 
Aayog. The major recommendations of this evaluation inter alia include integration of 
Swadhar Grehs and Ujjawala Homes, revision of the salary norms of the staff and use 
of information technology tools in the implementation of the Schemes. These schemes 
are now part of the  new Mission Shakti, which has life cycle continuum approach to 
women related issues. The recommendations have been duly incorporated in Mission 
Shakti. 
 
Both the schemes have provisions of shelter, food, clothing, counseling, medical aid, 
legal aid and vocational training to rehabilitate such women economically and 
emotionally. The schemes have provisions for trained staff and professionals for 
providing counseling and vocational training. A phased approach is adopted for re-
integration into the society by way of establishing Half-Way Home which is a home 
within the community, where a group of victims, ready for reintegration, live and work 
out of this place. To ensure proper implementation, Schemes have provisions for 
monitoring at District, State and Central levels.

(a)  the number of States that have started the implementation of the ambitious 
National Nutrition Mission/Bal Poshan Abhiyaan, targeted for children, 
pregnant women and lactating mothers, the details thereof; 
  
(b)  the details of the amount earmarked and the amount spent for the

(a)     POSHAN Abhiyaan was launched on 8th March, 2018 with the vision of a 
malnutrition-free India. The Abhiyaan aims to reduce malnutrition from the country in 
a phased manner and achieve improvement in nutritional status of Children from 0- 6 
years, Adolescent Girls, Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers in a time bound 
manner. The Abhiyaan has been rolled out in all the 36 States/UTs.

problems, as the tests recommended for the assessment of Specific Learning 
Disabilities (SLD) are outdated; and 
(c
) whether the parents and schools in the city also lack knowledge about what 
benefits can be availed from the concessions for the SLDs, which includes 
those diagnosed with dyslexia and autism, the details thereof? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a)       As informed by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilites 
(DEPwD), the Central Government notified the Rights of Persons with Disabilities 
(RPwD) Rules, 2017 on 15.06.2017, which inter-alia provide the procedure for issue 
of certificate of disability. Further, the Central Govt. notified the guidelines for 
assessment of various specified disabilities including Intellectual Disability, on 
04.01.2018. The competent medical authorities as notified by the States/UTs are 
required to issue certificate of disability as per these guidelines and in accordance 
with the RPwD Rules, 2017.  
  
(b)      DEPwD  issued the guidelines for assessment of various specified disabilities 
dated 04.01.2018 which were amended vide notification dated 09.12.2020 with 
respect to assessment of specific learning disability (SLD) to bring in more clarity for 
assessment by competent medical authority of the States/UTs. As per these 
amendments, psychiatrist has been included in the composition of the medical 
authority and it has been made clear that any person having tested positive on 
National Institute for Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) Battery is to be 
considered as a person with benchmark disability i.e. disability of more than 40%.  
  
(c)       DEPwD implements Awareness Generation programme to create awareness 
about the rights and entitlements of persons with disabilities through print, electronic 
and social media as well as through reputed organizations.   
518

  
Further, it is mentioned that Samagra Shiksha scheme which covers children 
from pre-primary to senior secondary, has a dedicated component for Inclusive 
Education for Children with Special Needs (CwSN) through which various provisions 
are made available for their educational needs such as, identification & assessment 
camps, provision of aids, appliances, assistive devices & teaching learning materials 
(TLMs) including, home based education for children with multiple &/ severe 
disabilities who are unable to attend school.  
  
The focus of Samagra Shiksha is on providing inclusive education to children 
with special needs wherein, children regardless of their abilities/disabilities participate 
and learn together in the same class, thus creating an enabling educational 
environment for all students.

 TARGETS UNDER PMMVY 
  
158.    DR. AMAR PATNAIK: 
                                                 
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
                            
(a) method and rationale behind the target estimate under PMMVY to be 51.7 lakhs 
women; 
(b) whether the target number of women under PMMVY scheme are only 40 per cent 
of the 128.7 lakhs (2017-18) eligible women in India;  
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; 
(d) whether target estimate been limited to only the first live birth of the women which 
constitutes only less than 49.5 per cent of births in India; 
(e) if so, the reasons therefor; 
(f) whether Government has any proposal to include second-live births in India 
annually under PMMVY; and 
(g) if so, the details thereof, if not, reasons therefor? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER FOR WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) to (e)         The maternity benefit under the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana 
(PMMVY) is available to the eligible beneficiaries for first living child of family. Normally, 
the first pregnancy of a woman exposes her to new kinds of challenges and stress 
factors. Hence, the scheme provides support to the mother for safe delivery and 
immunization of her first living child.  
  
As per Sample Registration System Statistical Report (SRS) 2018, published by the 
Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, Ministry of Home Affairs, 
the percentage of first order births in India is 49.5 % of the total live births. PMMVY 
covers all Pregnant Woman & Lactating Mothers (PW&LM), excluding PW&LM who are 
in regular employment with the Central Government or the State Governments or the 
Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) or those who are in receipt of similar benefits under 
any law for the time being in force. 
  
The PMMVY is estimated to cover 51.70 lakh beneficiaries annually. The targets under 
PMMVY are only indicative and States/Union Territories are enrolling more beneficiaries 
than the indicative targets. The total number of beneficiaries enrolled during each of the 
last three financial years under PMMVY is more than the indicative target. 
  
(f) and (g)   The PMMVY is a component under Mission Shakti  launched recently to 
provide integrated benefits to women.  As per the recommendations of the Expenditure 
Finance Committee's minutes on Mission Shakti, benefit for second child may be 
provided only if the second child is the girl child to discourage pre-birth-sex selection and 
promote the girl child.

STRENGTHENING OF PESA ACT 
 
160 PROF. MANOJ KUMAR JHA:  
 
Will the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government is planning to empower Panchayat (Extension to the Scheduled 
Areas) Act (PESA) by specifying rule -making powers and provide a time period by 
which State Governments have to frame rules under the said Act;  
(b) whether Government plan s to confer legal sanctity on National Resettlement and 
Rehabilitation Policy, 2007 to implement the provisions of PESA; and  
(c) whether the concerned States have framed appropriate rules under PESA to 
operationalise the said Act, including Bihar? 
 
ANSWER 
  
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR PANCHAYATI RAJ  
(SHRI KAPIL MORESHWAR PATIL) 
 
(a) Under “The Provisions of the Panchayats  (Extension to the Scheduled Areas), Act 1996 ” 
(PESA),  State Legislatures have been empowered to frame all laws concerning the extension 
of the provisions of Part IX of the Constitution relating to the Panchayats in Fifth Scheduled 
Areas,  subject to such exceptions and modificatio ns as are provided in section  4 of the Act. 
The Government has no proposal under consideration to bring about changes in the existing 
PESA Act. 
 
(b) Government of India has formulated the National Rehabilitation & Resettlement Policy, 
2007 to minimize large -scale displacement, as far as possible. The Policy also provides 
comprehensive rehabilitation & resettlement benefits to the displaced families. The policy 
covers all  projects leading to inv oluntary displacement of people.  Para 7.21 of this Policy  
envisages special provisions for Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes, which requires 
consultation with the concerned gram sabha or the panchayats at the appropriate level i n the 
Scheduled Areas under Fifth Schedule of the Constitution in accordance wi th PESA. Each 
affected family of Scheduled Tribe  followed by Scheduled Caste shall be given allotment of 
land for land, if Government Land is available in the resettlement Area. 
 
(c) PESA is an Act to provide for the extension of the provisions of Part IX of the Constitution 
relating to the Panchayats to the Scheduled Areas. In terms of section 2 of this Act, “Scheduled 
Areas” means the Scheduled Areas as referred to in clause (1) of article 244 of the Constitution. 
The State of Bihar is not covered under this definition.  Out of the ten PESA States, six States 
namely Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Telangana 
have framed their State PESA Rules.

ग्राम पांचायतों िो स्व-ववत्तपोवित बनाना 
8. श्री सांजय ससांहः 
क्या पांचायती राज मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककिः 
(क ) क्या सरकार ग्राम पंचायतों को स्व-ववत्तपोवित बनाने की योजना बना रही है ; 
(ख) यदि हााँ, तो इस संबंध में क्या-क्या किम उठाए गए हैं; और 
(ग) ग्रामीण भारत को स्व-ववत्तपोवित बनाने से अर्थव्यवस्र्ा पर क्या प्रभाव पडेगा? 
उत्तर 
पंचायती राज राज्यमंत्री 
(श्री कवपल मोरेश्वर पाटील) 
 
(क) और (ख) ‘पंचायत’, ‘स्र्ानीय शासन’ होने  के कारण , राज्य का वविय है और भारत के संववधान 
की सातवीं अन ुसूची की राज्य सूची का दहस्सा है। भारत के संववधान के भाग IX में अन ुच्छेि 243 
द्वारा पंचायतों की स्र्ापना के ललए संवैधाननक अधधिेश दिया गया है।  
संववधान में पंचायतों को स्वशासन के प्रभावी साधन के रूप में  पररकल्पपत ककया गया है। 
अन ुच्छेि 243छ के अन ुसार, राज्य का ववधान -मंडल, ववधध द्वारा, उपय ुक्त स्तर पर,ऐसी शतों के 
अधीन रहते ह ुए, जो उन्हें आधर्थक ववकास और समाल्जक न्याय के ललए योजनाएं तैयार करने  तर्ा 
आधर्थक ववकास और समाल्जक नयाय की ऐसी स्कीमों, जो उन्हे सौंपी जाएं, ल्जनके अंतगथत वे स्कीमें 
भी है, जो ग्यारहवी अनुसूची में सूचीबद्ध ववियो के संबंध में है , को लाग ु करने  हेतु पंचायतों को 
शल्क्तयां और प्रधधकार प्रिान कर सकेगा।  
पंचायतों के ववत्तीय सशल्क्तकरण के ललए संववधान के अन ुच्छेि 243ज, अन ुच्छेि 280(3)(खख) 
और अन ुच्छेि 243झ के तहत प्रावधान ककए गए हैं।  
अन ुच्छेि 243एच के अनुसार, राज्य ववधानसभाएं, कान ून द्वारा, पंचायतों को कर , शुपक , टोल 
और फीसें लगाने , एकत्र करने और ववननयोल्जत करने के ललए ; शतों और सीमाओं के अधीन पंचायतों 
को ऐसे करों , शुपकों , टोलों और फीसों को सौं पने ; राज्य की संधचत ननधध से पंचायतों को सहायता 
अन ुिान प्रिान करने , और अपने धन को जमा करने के ललए अपना स्वयं का कोि बनाने के ललये  
अधधक ृत कर सकती हैं।

अन ुच्छेि 280(3)(खख) के अन ुसार, क ें द्रीय ववत्त आयोग का यह कतथव्य होगा कक वह राज्य के 
ववत्त आयोग द्वारा की गई लसफाररशों के आधार पर राज्य में पंचायतों के संसाधनों की अन ुपूनतथ के 
ललए ककसी राज्य की संधचत ननधध के संवधथन के ललए आवश्यक अध्य ुपायों के बारे मेंराष्ट्रपनत को

(क) वि गत तीन िर्षों क े  दौरान राजस्थान राज्य को मंत्रालय की विभिन्द्न योजनाओं क े  अंतगगत आिंटित/

(ख) क्या सरकार राजस्थान राज्य क े  भलए भिक्षा क े  क्षेत्र में कोई वििेर्ष योजना लाने का विचार रखती 
है; और  
(ग) यटद हां , तो तत्संबंिी ब्यौरा क्या है और यटद नह ं , तो इसक े  क्या कारण हैं ? 
 
उत्तर 
भिक्षा मंत्रालय में राज् य मंत्री 
(श्रीमती अन्द् नपूणाग देिी) 
(क ) से (ग): इस मंत्रालय द्िारा भिक्षा को स ुगम बनाने क े  भलए राजस्थान में लाग ू की गई 
योजनाओं/कायगक्रमों का वििरण नीचे टदया गया है:  
 
समग्र शिक्षा: राज्य और संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों क े  साथ समन्द्िय और परामिग से पूरे देि में ग ुणित्तापूणग भिक्षा 
क े  सािगिौभमकरण क े  भलए 2018-19 में समग्र भिक्षा िुरू की गई थी। यह स्क ू ल भिक्षा क्षेत्र क े  भलए प्री-
स्कू ल से 12 िीं कक्षा तक का व्यापक कायगक्रम है और इसका उद्दे श्य स्कू ल भिक्षा क े  सिी स्तरों पर 
समािेिी और समान ग ुणित्ता िाल  भिक्षा सुननश्श्चत करना है। इस योजना को अब एनईपी  2020 की 
भसफाररिों क े  अन ुरूप बनाया गया है।  
 
इस योजना  के  तहत स्कू ल भिक्षा के  सिी स्तरों पर  प्रस्तावित प्रमुख पहलें हैं: ( i) अिसंरचना  विकास  और  
प्रनतिारण सटहत सािगिौभमक पहुंच; (ii) मूलिू
त साक्षरता और  संख्या ज्ञान, (iii) जेंडर  और  समता; (iv) समािेिी 
भिक्षा; (v) गुणित्ता और  निाचार ; (vi) भिक्षक िेतन  के  भलए वित्तीय सहायता; (vii) डडश्जिल पहल; (viii) िदी, 
पाठ्यपुस्तक आटद सटहत आरि ई पात्रता; (ix) ईसीसीई के  भलए सहायता; (x) व्यािसानयक भिक्षा; (xi) खेल और  
िार ररक  भिक्षा; (xii) अध्यापक भिक्षा और  प्रभिक्षण का  सुदृढ करण ; (xiii) ननगरानी ; (xiv) कायगक्रम प्रबंिन; और  
(xv) राष्ट्र य घिक।

प्रधानमंत्री पोषण िक्तत ननमााण (पीएम पोषण): पीएम पोर्षण योजना एक क ें र प्रायोश्जत योजना है जो 
सरकार  और सरकार  सहायता प्राप्त स्कू लों में बालिाटिका (कक्षा I से प ूिग) और कक्षा I-VIII में पढने 
िाले सिी स्कू ल  बच्चों को किर करती है। पीएम पोर्षण क े  उद्देश्य हैं: 
 
I. सरकार  और सरकार  सहायता प्राप्त स्क ू लों में कक्षा I–VIII में पढने िाले बच्चों क े  पोर्षण 
 स्तर में सुिार। 
II. िंधचत िगों क े  गर ब बच्चों को ननयभमत रूप से स्क ू ल जाने क े  भलए प्रोत्साटहत करना और 
 उनकी कक्षा गनतविधियों पर ध्यान क ें टरत करने में मदद करना।  
III. ग्रीष्ट्म अिकाि क े  दौरान सूखा/आपदा प्रिावित क्षेत्रों में प्राथभमक स्तर क े बच्चों को 
 पोर्षाहार सहायता प्रदान करना। 
 
 
राष्ट्रीय साधन-सह-योग्यता छात्रिृवत्त योजना (एनएमएमएसएस): 'राष्ट्र य सािन-सह-योग्यता छात्रिृवत्त 
योजना ' (एनएमएमएसएस) कक्षा IX से XII तक क े  मेिािी छात्रों को छात्रिृवत्त प्रदान करने क े  भलए एक 
क ें र य क्षेत्र योजना है। योजना का उद्देश्य आधथगक रूप से कमजोर िगग क े  मेिािी छात्रों का  आठिीं कक्षा 
में ड्रॉप आउि को रोकने क े  भलए छात्रि ृवत्त प्रदान करना और उन्द्हें अपना अध्ययन जार  रखने और 
माध्यभमक स्तर को पूरा करने क े  भलए प्रोत्साटहत करना है। इस योजना में कक्षा IX क े  चयननत छा त्रों 
को प्रत्येक िर्षग एक लाख नई छात्रिृवत्तयां प्रदान करने और राज्य सरकार, सरकार  सहायता प्राप्त और 
स्थानीय ननकाय स्कू लों में अध्ययन क े  भलए कक्षा X से XII में छात्रिृवत्तयों ननरंतरता/ उनक े  निीकरण की 
पररकल्पना की गई है।  
स्टासा पररयोजना: राज्यों क े  भलए भिक्षण-अधिगम और पररणामों को स ुदृढ करना (स्िासग) पररयोजना 
स्कू ल भिक्षा और साक्षरता वििाग क े  तहत एक नई क ें र प्रायोश्जत योजना है। इस पररयोजना में 
राजस्थान सटहत 6 राज्य िाभमल हैं। पहचान ककए गए राज्यों को भिक्षा की ग ुणित्ता में सुिार हेतु 
विभिन्द्न कायों क े  भलए  सहयोग टदया जाता है।

     क्याशिक्षा मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे कक:  
(क)  क्या सरकार को इस बात की जानकारी है कक देश के अधिकांश ननजी स्वाममत्व वाले और  न्यास प्रबंधित 
स्कूलों में मशक्षा का स्तर आवश्यकता से काफी नीचे है और इन्हें मुख्य रूप से व्यावसानयक दृष्टि से खोला 
गया है।  
(ख)  क्या यह भी सच है कक ऐसे स्कूलों में कम पढे -मलखे और अन ुभवहीन मशक्षक हैं और इससे संबंधित स्कूलों 
का स्तर और खराब हो जाता है ;  
(ग)  सरकार ऐसे स्कूलों के स्तर में सुिार के मलए क्या काररवाई करने का ववचार रखती है ; और  
(घ)  क्या सरकार की ऐसे सभी स्कूलों में रोजगार प्राप्त करने के मलए राज्य स्तरीय पात्रता परीक्षा शुरू करने 
की कोई योजना है ? 
उत्तर 
शिक्षा मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री  
(श्रीमती अन्नपूर्ाा देिी) 
 
(क ) से (घ): मशक्षा संवविान की समवती स ूची का ववषय है और क ें द्र सरकार के स्वाममत्व वाले/ववत्त पोवषत स्कूलों 
के अलावा अन्य स्कूल राज्य सरकारों के अधिकार क्षेत्र में हैं। 
सीबीएसई से संबद्ि अधिकांश ननजी स्कूलों के वावषरक पररणाम आवश्यकताओं के अन ुरूप और उत्तीणर 
प्रनतशतता और मेिावी छात्रों की  दृष्ट ि  से अच्छे रहे  हैं। 
सीबीएसई के संबद्िता उपननयम 2018 के खंड 9.1.1 में कहा गया है कक स्क ूल चलाने वाली सोसायिी / 
ट्रस्ि/ कंपनी यह स ुननष्श्चत करेगी कक स्कूल एक साम ु
दानयक सेवा के रूप में चलाया  जाता है, ना  कक एक  व्यवसाय 
के रूप में और स्क ूल में ककसी भी तरह से  व्यावसायीकरण नहीं होता है।  
 सीबीएसई के संबद्िता उपननयमों के अन ुसार, मशक्षण स्िाफ (प्रिानाचायर/उप प्रिानाचायर/स्कूल प्रमुख 
सहहत) के मलए न्यूनतम योग्यता ननम्नमलखखत के अन ु
सार होनी चाहहए:  
➢ समय -समय पर यथासंशोधित  और अधिसूधचत राटट्रीय अध्यापक मशक्षा पररषद (पूवर-प्राथममक, प्राथममक, उच्च

➢ सम ुधचत सरकार , जहां स् कूल ष्स् थत है , द्वारा मशक्षक भती ननयमावली  या केन्द्रीय ववद्यालय संगठन या 
नवोदय ववद्यालय सममनत की  मशक्षक भती ननयमावली  में ननिारररत न्यूनतम योग्यता। 
➢ सीबीएसई द्वारा प्रस् तुत ववषयों के मशक्षकों की न्य ूनतम योग्यता जैसाकक  सीबीएसई द्वारा ननिारररत ककया

44 # श्री दीपक प्रकाि: 
 
क्याशिक्षा मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे कक : 
(क ) क्या झारखंड में कोई नया विश्िविद्यालय स्थावपत ककया जा रहा है;और  
(ख) तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
शिक्षा मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री  
(डॉ. सुभाष सरकार ) 
 
(क ) और (ख): क ें द्रीय विश्िविद्यालय की स्थापना एक सतत प्रकिया है। हालांकक, िततमान 
में झारखंड में एक नया क ें द्रीय विश्िविद्यालय स्थावपत करने के  ललए मंत्रालय में कोई 
प्रस्ताि विचाराधीन नहीं है। क ें द्रीय विश्िविद्यालय अधधननयम, 2009 के तहत रांची , झारखंड 
में एक क ें द्रीय विश्िविद्यालय पहले ही स्थावपत ककया जा चुका है।

एड-टेक क्षेत्र का विननयमन 
45 श्री संजय शसंहः  
क्या शिक्षा मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे कक:  
(क) क्या सरकार को एड -टेक क्षेत्र में कुछ कंपननयों के एकाधिकार और शोषणकारी प्रथाओं के बारे 
में जानकारी है ;  
(ख) यदि हां, तो तत्संबंिी ब्यौरा क्या है और इस मुद्िे से ननपटने के लिए क्या किम उठाए गए हैं ;  
(ग) क्या सरकार हमारे िेश के शैक्षक्षक मानकों में स ुिार िाने और ग्रामीण भारत में शैक्षक्षक तंत्र की 
बेहतर पहुंच के लिए इस क्षेत्र की कंपननयों के साथ सहयोग करने की योजना बना रही है ; और  
(घ) यदि हां, तो तत्संबंिी ब्यौरा क्या है? 
उत् तर 
शिक्षा मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री  
(डॉ. सुभाष सरकार ) 
(क ) और  (ख) एड-टेक कं पननयों की शोषणकारी प्रथाओं से बचाव के लिए , सरकार ने दहतिारक के 
लिए एडवाइजरी जारी की है  जजसमें वे  क्या करें और क्या न करें शालमि है । इसने उन नागररकों 
को स ूचना िेने हेतु ई-कॉमसस फमों के लिए कान ूनी प्राविानों को भी िोहराया है जो एड -टेक सेवाओं 
के उपभोक्ता हैं।  वववरण https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1784582 पर 
िेखे जा सकते हैं।  यूजीसी और एआईसीटीई ने भी सावसजननक नोदटस जारी कर छात्रों को ककसी भी 
पाठ्यक्रम में नामांकन से पहिे आधिकाररक वेबसाइट पर कायसक्रम की मान्यता/पात्रता की जथथनत 
की जांच करने की सिाह िी है।  
(ग) और  (घ) लशक्षाधथसयों की सुवविा के लिए एक मंच पर सवोत्तम तकनीकी प्रोडक््स को िाने के 
लिए, एआईसीटीई द्वारा सावसजननक -ननजी भागीिारी मॉडि में राष्ट्रीय शैक्षक्षक प्रौद्योधगकी गठबंिन 
(एनईएटी) श ुरू ककया गया है।  वववरण https://neat.aicte-india.org/ पर िेखे जा सकते हैं।

ऑडिट पूछताछ, ड्राफ्ट स्र्ानीय ऑडिट ररपोटथ, ड्राफ्ट ऑडिट-पैरा आदि के सलए प्रकिया को स ुव्यवब्स्र्त

रखरखाव स ुननब्श्चत करता है।

अभी तक वर्थ 2021 -22 के ललए 2.55  लाख ग्राम पंचायतों ने अपनी ग्राम पंचायत ववकास

सुधार के ललए राज्यों के सार् सतत रूप से प्रयास कर रहा है।

90 श्री संजय सेठ: 
क् या सड़क पररवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंर्े कक:  
(क) क् या इस् पात और सीमेंट की अत् यधिक कीमतों के कारण सड़कों के ननमागण की लार्त कई र् ुणा बढ़

(ख) यदि हां, तो तत् संबंिी ब् यौरा क् या है; 
(र्) क् या सरकार इस् पात और सीमेंट के उपयोर् को कम करने के ललए सड़कों के ननमागण में काबगन स् टी ल 
और स् टील फाईबर जैसे नए कच् चे  माल का उपयोर् करने की योजना बना रही है ; और  
(घ) यदि हां, तो तत् संबंिी ब् यौरा क् या है? 
उत्‍ तर 
सड़क पररवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्री  
(श्री नननतन जयराम र्डकरी)  
(क) और (ख) डब््यूपीआई/अन्य सू
चकांकों से ज ु
ड़ी राजमार्ग पररयोजनाओं के अन ु
बंि समझौते में मू
्य 
समायोजन का प्राविान है। ठेकेिार को अन ुबंि करार के प्राविानों  के अन ुसार इस्पात, सीमेंट और अन्य 
सामधियों की कीमतों में व ृद्धि होने पर  मुआवजा दिया जाता  है। 
(र्) और (घ) भारतीय सड़क कांिेस और सड़क पररवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय ने कंक्रीट में सीमेंट की 
मात्रा को कम करने के ललए कंक्रीट में फ्लाईएश, िाउंड िेन्युलर ब्लास्ट फननगश स्लैर् जैसे सीमेंटय ु
क्त 
र्ुणों वाले अपलशष्ट पिार्थों का उपयोर् करने के ललए दिशाननिेश जारी ककए हैं। सड़क पररवहन और 
राजमार्ग मंत्रालय ने राजमार्ों के ननमागण में नई/वैकज्पक सामिी और प्रौद्योधर्ककयों का उपयोर् करने के 
ललए दिनांक 14.12.2020 को ववस्तृत दिशा-ननिेश जारी ककए हैं। ऐसी क ुछ सामिी/प्रौद्योधर्ककयां सड़क 
ननमागण में इस्पात और सीमेंट को कम करने में भी मिि करती हैं। उिाहरण के ललए , हाल ही में राष्रीय 
राजमार्ग पररयोजनाओं पर अ्रा -हाई परफॉमेंस फाइबर प्रबललत कंक्रीट का उपयोर् श ुरू ह ुआ है जजससे 
इस्पात और सीमेंट की मात्रा में काफी बचत होती है।

(क ) क्या देशभर में बच्चों के  शोषण/हहसा और यौन शोषण की  घटनाओं की  संख्या में तेजी से बढोत्तरी

उत्‍तर 
श्रीमती स्‍मृहत जूहबन इरानी     महहला एवं बाल हवकास  मंत्री 
 
(क ) से (ग) : राष् ‍ट्रीय अपराध ररकाडड  ब्‍यूरो द्वारा प्रदान की  गई सूचना के  अनुसार, वषड 2016 से 
2020 के  दौरान बच्‍चों के  हखलाफ अपराधों के  अंतगडत पंजीक ृ त मामलों, आरोप पत्र दाहखल ककए  गए 
मामलों, दोषहसि मामलों, हगरफ्तार ककए  गए व्‍यहियों, आरोप पत्र दाहखल ककए  गए व्‍यहियों तथा 
दोषहसि व्‍यहियों का  राज् ‍य/संघ राज् ‍य क्षेत्र-वार और अपराध शीषड-वार हववरण क्रमश: अनुलग्‍नक -। 
और अनुलग्‍नक -।। में संलग्‍न है।  
 
 भारत सरकार  द्वारा पाररत ककए  गए यौन अपराधों से बालकों  का संरक्षण (पोक ् ‍सो) अहधहनयम, 
2012 में बच्‍चों को  यौन शोषण से बचाने के  हलए सुरक्षोपाय ककए  गए हैं। इस अहधहनयम में 18 वषड 
से कम  आयु के  व्‍यहि को बालक  के  रूप  में पररभाहषत ककया  गया है। पोक ् ‍सो अहधहनयम, 2012 में 
मामलों के  तेजी से हवचारण को  सुहनहित करने  के  उद्देश्‍य से हवशेष न्‍यायालयों की  स्‍थापना की

बच्‍चों के  हखलाफ यौन अपराध करने  वाले अपराहधयों में भय पैदा ककया  जा सक े और ऐसे अपराधों को  
रोका  जा सक े ।  
 
 इसक े अहतररक ् ‍त, बच्‍चों को  शोषण/हहसा और यौन शोषण से संरक्षण प्रदान करने  के  हलए

पोक ् ‍सो हनयमावली, 2020 में अन्‍य बातों के  साथ-साथ स्‍क ू लों और देखभाल गृहों में कमडचाररयों

स्‍वास् ‍थ्‍य जांच, और (vi) हनदेशपरक  सेवाएं शाहमल हैं; इन्‍हें आंगनवाडी  क ें द्र के  मंच के  माध्‍यम से

152. श्री मो. नदीमुल िकः  
 
 क्या महिला एवं बाल हवकास  मंत्री यि बताने की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक :  
  
(क ) क्या यि सच िै कक  महिलाओं को  प्रधान मंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना के  ऄंतगडत प्रदान ककए  
जाने वाले लामों का  फायदा ईठाने के  हलए पहत के  अधार काडड  की  अवश्यकता िोती िै;  
(ख) यकद िााँ, तो आसक े क्या कारण  िैं;  
(ग) क्या माताओं या गभडवती महिलाओं के  हलए ऄन्‍य सरकारी  कायडक्रमों िेतु भी ऐसी िी 
अवश्‍यकताएं  पड़ती िैं, यकद िााँ, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या िै;  
(घ) क्या सरकार  को  आस बात की  जानकारी  िै कक  आसमें एकल  माताओं, मौसमी प्रवाहसयों, 
पररत्यक्य पहियों अकद जैसे संभाहवत लाभाथी शाहमल िोने से वंहचत रि जाते िैं;  
(ङ) क्या सरकार  ने आस कायडक्रम में ऐसे ऄंतर का  ऄध्ययन करने  और आसका  समाधान करने  के  
हलए कोइ  तंत्र ऄपनाया िै; और  
(च) यकद िााँ, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या िै और यकद निीं, तो आसक े क्या कारण  िैं? 
 
ईत्‍तर 
श्रीमती स्‍मृहत जूहबन आरानी     महिला एवं बाल हवकास  मंत्री 
 
(क ) और ( ख) : महिला और बाल हवकास  मंत्रालय क ें द्रीय प्रायोहजत प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना 
योजना (पीएमएमवीवाइ) का  कायाडन्वयन कर  रिा िै हजसक े तित क ु छ शतों को  पूरा करने  पर 
गभडवती महिलाओं और स्तनपान कराने  वाली माताओं ( पीडब््यू एंड  एलएम) को  पिले बच्चे के  
हलए तीन ककस्तों में 5000/-रुपये का  मातृत्व लाभ कदया जा रिा िै। पीएमएमवीवाइ के  तित 
मातृत्व लाभ लेने के  हलए लाभाथी को  ऄपना और ऄपने पहत के  अधार हववरण देने िोते िैं जो 
डाटाबेस  में क ै प्चर ककए  जाते िैं। 
 
(ग) : महिला और बाल हवकास  मंत्रालय द्वारा माताओं या गभडवती महिलाओं के  हलए 
कक्रयाहन्वत की  जा रिी ऄन्य स्कीमों के  तित ऐसी कोइ  अवश्यकता निीं िै।  
 
(घ) : पीएमएमवीवाइ ओहडशा  और तेलंगाना को  छोड़कर  सभी राज्यों/संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों में 
कक्रयाहन्वत की  जा रिी िै। सामहयक  प्रवासी आस स्कीम का  लाभ ककसी  भी ऐसे राज्य/संघ राज्य 
क्षेत्र से ईठा सकते  िैं, जो आस स्कीम का  कायाडन्वयन कर  रिे िैं।  
 
984

 आसक े ऄलावा, आस स्कीम के  तित पंजीकरण  के  हलए, लाभाथी को  मातृत्व लाभ लेने के  
हलए ऄन्य बातों के  साथ-साथ, ऄपनी और ऄपने पहत की  हलहखत सिमहत देनी िोती िै।   
 
(ड .) और (च) : नीहत अयोग के  हवकास  और हनगरानी मू्यांकन  कायाडलय  ने पीएमएमवीवाइ 
सहित महिला और बाल हवकास  मंत्रालय की  क ें द्रीय प्रायोहजत स्कीमों का  मू्यांकन  ककया  और 
आसकी  हसफाररशों पर हवचार ककया  जा चुका  िै। तदनुसार, एकल  माता और पररत्यक्त माता के  
समावेश को  सुहवधाजनक  बनाने के  हलए हमशन शहक्त के  तित पीएमएमवीवाइ घटक  के  संशोहधत 
कदशाहनदेशों में पहत की  हलहखत सिमहत और अधार को  एक  ऄहनवायड मानदंड  निीं बनाने की  
पररक्पना  की  गइ िै।

में सक्षम नहीं बनाती हैं, और  
(च) यकद  हााँ, तो आन स्थानों से मुक्त होने के  बाद समाज में ईनका  पुन: समायोजन  करने में

ईत्‍तर 
श्रीमती स्‍मृहत जूहबन आरानी     महहला  एवं बाल हवकास  मंत्री 
 
(क ) से (च) : सरकार दुर्व्ायपार की  रोकथाम  और वाहणहज्यक  यौन  शोषण के  हलए दुर्व्ायपार 
के  पीह़ितों के  बचाव, पुनवायस और पुन:समेकन  के  हलए ईज्ज्वला स्कीम का  कायायन्द्वयन  करती है। 
स्वाधार गृह स्कीम कठठन  पठरहस्थहतयों  में रह रही महहलाओं  की  प्राथहमक जरूरतों की  पूर्तत करती  
है। ईज्ज्वला और स्वाधार गृह स्कीमों का  नीहत अयोग  द्वारा मूलयांकन  ककया  गया  है। आस 
मूलयांकन  की  मुख्य  हसफाठरशों में ऄन्द्य बातों के  साथ-साथ, स्वाधार गृहों और ईज्ज्वला गृहों का  
समेकन , कमयचाठरयों  के  वेतन मानदंड में संशोधन और स्कीमों के  कायायन्द्वयन  में सूचना प्रौद्योहगकी 
ईपकरणों  का  ईपयोग  शाहमल है। ये  स्कीमें ऄब नइ हमशन शहक्त के  भाग हैं हजसका  महहलाओं  से 
संबंहधत मुद्दों के  प्रहत जीवनचक्र हनरंतरता का  दृहिकोण  है। आन हसफाठरशों को  हमशन शहक्त में 
हवहधवत शाहमल ककया  गया  है।

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d ) OF STARRED 
QUESTION NO. 31  BY SHRI RAM NATH THAKUR ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA 
ON 04.02.2022 REGARDING CONSTRUCTION OF OVER BRIDGE NEAR 
KARPURIGRAM              
(a) to (d): Yes, Sir.  Karpurigram Railway station comes under Sonpur Division of East Central 
Railway. A College, High School and Health unit are closely situated in north of Karpurigram station.   
This college, school and health unit are in one campus and the entrance is from Railway goods shed 
road which is connected with two level crossings (LCs) (LC No. 58 and 59) one at each end of the 
station.  About 53 no. of trains pass through the station per day, which necessitates the closure of LCs 
for safety.  In addition, average 2 rakes are received on Good shed (Rake point) at this station per day 
which requires closure of LCs during shunting.  
 LC No. 59 is located on west side of station having Train Vehicle Unit (TVU) of 
49397. ROB at this LC, located in busy yard, may be considered by Railways on cost-sharing 
basis subject to its feasibility.  No proposal in this regard has been received from State 
Government.  Road Under Bridge (RUB) at  this location is  technically not feasible due to less bank 
height.

(a) and (b):Social media platforms like Twitter and Facebook qualify as Intermediaries as per 
the information Technology (IT) Act, 2000. The Government is committed to ensure that the 
Internet in India is Open, Safe & Trusted and Accountable for all users. 
 
In line with the above objectives, the Government has notified the Information Technology 
(Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Codes) Rules, 2021 on 25th February, 2021 
to ensure that the internet is safe and trusted. The Rules also provide for additional due 
diligence to be followed by Significant Social Media Intermediaries.   
 
In case of non-compliance, rule 7 of these Rules becomes applicable and the intermediaries 
are liable to lose their exemption from liability under section 79 of the IT Act, 2000.

Chief Compliance Officer, Grievance Officer and Nodal Person of Contact and have also 
informed this Ministry about physical contact address in India. They are also publishing 
monthly compliance reports on their platforms.
